work_product: Build a Pokemon save editor prototype as a wrapper/companion around the PKHeX ecosystem, not a ground-up parser. Start with a read-only save inspector that opens sample saves, detects game/generation, displays trainer and party/box metadata, and exports a no-mutation receipt. PKSM is useful as a homebrew UX reference, while PKHeX for Web/PKMDS show a browser/WASM path. Only add one narrow edit lane after backups, checksums, and round-trip tests are proven.
